description: This file contains functional tests for device IP and device info handlers, using pytest and rbus utility functions to get and set data elements related to device IP configurations, device info, services, and reverse SSH features.

methods.name: test_DeviceDefault_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Tests getting and setting device info data elements such as SoftwareVersion, ModelName, FirmwareFilename, and a feature toggle, using rbus_get_data and rbus_set_data.

methods.name: test_DeviceIP_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Verifies read access to various IPv6 and IPv4 related data elements in the device's IP interface, asserting expected values and statuses.

methods.name: test_DeviceServices_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Checks the number of device service entries.

methods.name: test_ReverseSSH_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Validates the reverse SSH status and config triggers, including setting commands and verifying responses.
